title: Before ever meeting the companion Tamsin, the reeve's dialogue option read 'promise to seal the barrow (Tamsin +1, Brother Osk -1)' — easy to misread as the reeve's own name, since no one named Tamsin had been introduced yet (she turned out to be the smith's apprentice, met later across the square).
